outputs.explanation: Spatial clustering map (categorical Seurat cluster assignments overlaid on tissue) is a spatial/heatmap-style visualization, not a bar chart of averaged replicate data; individual data points are not applicable.
H&E histology image with manual region annotations; no averaged/summary data is plotted, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Continuous spatial gene-expression (Log2 Exp) maps are heatmap-style visualizations overlaid on tissue, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots (running enrichment score curves), a plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph showing log2 fold change per gene (derived from group comparisons via Seurat FindMarkers) displays only single summary bars with no overlaid individual data points (e.g., per-spot expression values), and this plot type is not among the exempt categories (box/violin, heatmap, line, pie/Venn, scatter).
